entries.ecbe1540604fd83d: The business operates restaurants in Japan and overseas, including Gusto, Bamiyan, Shabuyo, Jonathan's, Yumeian and Sasan Udon. In Japan, the business is carried out by four companies: Skylark Restaurants, Nilax, Tomato & Associates and Sasan. Overseas, subsidiaries in Taiwan, Malaysia and the United States operate restaurants under brand licenses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥447,379 million, an increase of ¥56,242 million from the previous year, and this business is the only reportable segment. As of December 31, 2025, the group had 3,111 stores, including 4 stores not yet open that are being prepared for conversion.
